analyst_note: IPO-PIPELINE NODE RE-VERIFIED; RUNS EVIDENCE STILL PENDING BY CONSTRUCTION. The interconnections node that went UNVERIFIED on 08-06 was re-checked today and the pipeline is BIFURCATING, not freezing. Anthropic is advancing on its original timetable: confidential draft S-1 submitted 06-01, bankers running investor meetings since ~07-15 (roadshows typically precede pricing by 4-8 weeks), October listing target intact, ~$965B valuation, GS/JPM/Morgan Stanley leading. Its S-1 has NOT yet gone public — verified directly rather than from press: an EDGAR company search for "anthropic" across all form types returns ZERO registrants, which is what a still-confidential DRS looks like. OpenAI is the leg that moved: NYT reported ~06-25, citing three people in internal deliberations, that its listing slips to 2027 to hold out for a $1T valuation, with advisers' choice framed as 2027-at-$1T versus sooner-at-less and Altman calling any cut a "nonstarter". OpenAI has NOT publicly confirmed and no date is official; Kalshi prices a formal announcement at 59% by 2027-03-01. Two qualifications on this item, both material: (i) it is LATE-JUNE news newly surfaced to this monitor, not an August development — it corrects a gap in our coverage rather than recording a change in the world, and no August-dated read on either listing was obtainable today; (ii) press attributes the deferral DIRECTLY to SpaceX's rocky debut, which is the first observed instance of the reflexive stock-as-currency loop propagating OUTWARD — SPCX's own weakness now cited as a cause of another issuer's decision, where AMBER's "wobble" language anticipated only sentiment. Held at AMBER rather than escalated because the nearer and larger pipeline event, Anthropic, has NOT slipped: if SPCX's decline had closed the mega-cap window, Anthropic would be the first thing to move, and it hasn't. Separately, the RUNS de-escalation evidence remains unavailable and today's null is uninformative: EDGAR shows ZERO Form 4s filed by SPCX on 08-06 or 08-07 (verified against the daily indexes, which were fresh — 1,161 and 1,159 market-wide Form 4s on those days, zero naming SPCX; method control-checked against the known 06-17 SPCX Form 4, which does appear under the issuer name). The Section 16 deadline for unlock-day transactions is two business days, i.e. end of Monday 2026-08-10, so the window had not closed. NEWLY IDENTIFIED AND STRUCTURAL: the runs de-escalation clause asks for evidence that can never fully arrive. Form 4 covers only Section 16 people — SPCX filed ~10 Form 3s at IPO, so roughly ten individuals — while the 911.5M unlocked shares are overwhelmingly rank-and-file employee holdings that generate no Form 4 ever. The test is therefore asymmetric: a busy Form 4 tape disconfirms strongly, a quiet one confirms weakly, and de-escalating on a quiet tape alone would repeat the error the 08-06 hold avoided.

runs.driving_observable: HELD AT AMBER — de-escalation candidate, not yet de-escalated. The armed catalyst fired and did NOT produce the RED marker: the compound test was a turnover spike ON FALLING price, and the session delivered a turnover spike on RISING price (2.0-2.1x average volume, close +6.14%). The 'break below the recent ~$108-111 lows on elevated volume' clause was touched intraday ($105.11, a new all-time low) but reversed within the session to close near the high — a supply test met by demand, which is the opposite of a run. Two reasons this is not yet GREEN. (1) The de-escalation clause requires 'modest REALIZED selling', and realized selling is unobservable today: Form 4s lag up to two business days, so no insider-disposition data exists yet for 08-06. Absent that, a GREEN call would rest on price action alone. (2) The structural run capacity rose sharply — free float went 4.9% -> 11.8% of shares outstanding — and only the first 20% tranche is out, with further staggered tranches through the 2026-12-08 full expiry. The mechanism is better-capitalized against a run than yesterday in sentiment terms and materially worse in structural terms.
